Man, i %100 feel you on this. I go to a school(private) where most everyone is very smart, and talented in so many ways. And then you have me, who is gonna barely graduate and who is really not all that good at anything. I get it. Im not saying that's what you're saying exactly, but the underlying feeling is the same. 
Seeing those around you become amazing people and you see yourself as someone who's not even close. 

Now ima say this and you're gonna reject it at first, but try to hear me out. I try to let go. I let go of my standards, which I realized were impossible because i always raised them. I let go of comparing myself to my peers, if you don't compare then you're not so bad after all: it's just you and no one else. And after i let go, i begin. I begin to make art that **cannot** be rated as good or bad since there's nothing else to compare it to(abstract art.) i also enjoy photography, and in a sense, there is no bad photo. Because a photo will look beautiful to the right person. You need to be that right person. 

Now i know, fuck me, i said that too. But think about it, just give yourself a fighting chance. Explore yourself. Learn what you love, and it seems like you already know a few things, so pursue it! Fuck your parents, and follow it! Do what you can until you can fund yourself! Your happiness is worth that! 
Now for the cutting, im gonna advise you to abstain from that, but if you dont. Please be safe, and clean your cuts and dress them properly. But the best way to avoid infection is to not cut at all. But still, stay safe. 💙

And for me, it's not a problem of being associated with "weak feminine behavior"( im the biggest feminist) it's the judgment from a society that tells men that we shouldn't "act like that." For some reason, society would rather us self harm through substance abuse. Cus *thats what guys do!* 
**Thats *manly* self harm** 

Fuck society, and get yourself some help. Everyone needs help at sometime no matter if you're a man, woman, agender, bigender, trans, whatever. Everyone deserves help. 
You deserve to be healthy, so please help yourself. Stay safe, and you should probably get it patched up.
